description: ADDED BY MENTOR. Reliability is the engineer's job, not the model's. Every run must be traceable and auditable, or you cannot debug a bad review or defend a good one.

decision_log.storage: append-only JSONL via `lazycoder --log PATH`; never rewritten in place. A database is a later swap, not a prerequisite.
record_per_run: rule_results (outcome, severity, finding or abstention note)
decision_log.replay: `lazycoder replay LOG` recomputes derive_verdict from each JSONL record with no model call; exit non-zero on drift
